usable_valid_p3.definition: HARD_VALID_P3 plus predeclared maneuver-transition and braking realizability conditions already present in production ranking diagnostics

conditions.physical_rationale: the post-cluster exit ramp must not enter a later obstacle's clearance-expanded Frenet interval before merge
the remaining forward distance must cover configured response delay plus speed-dependent braking distance to the candidate speed profile

rationale_for_no_extra_margin_threshold: footprint, slope, directional curvature and curvature-rate are already hard gates; center-track is not the rotated footprint; obstacle and normalized slack are ranking measurements with scope/reserve semantics that differ from the maneuver-bounded hard obstacle check; velocity loss and global deviation are quality objectives without frozen safety cutoffs
